decisions.briefing: The market had a risk-off day: the NASDAQ fell 1.6% and the S&P 500 fell 1.1%, so the screener returned no candidates. I am holding all 7 positions and keeping the $545.88 in cash. The automatic stop-losses and profit targets will handle exits, and I will not sell good positions just because of one weak day.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell across the board today. The NASDAQ dropped 1.6% and the S&P 500 lost 1.1%, which puts the session firmly in risk-off territory. No news headlines were provided in today's data, so this summary cannot name a specific cause. The larger fall in the tech-heavy NASDAQ suggests investors sold growth and high-valuation stocks first, a common pattern when traders want less risk.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面下跌，納斯達克指數跌1.6%，標普500指數跌1.1%，市場明顯轉為避險。由於今日數據未附帶新聞標題，無法確定觸發拋售的具體消息。科技股比重較高的納指跌幅更大，反映資金先行撤出成長股及高估值板塊，屬於典型的風險偏好降溫走勢。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like tech and growth stocks, often moving money into safer places. Because prices can keep falling during these periods, a careful strategy is to pause new buying instead of trying to catch the bottom. Positions you already hold stay protected by preset stop-loss levels.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）指投資者情緒轉趨謹慎，紛紛拋售科技股、成長股等高風險資產，並將資金轉移至較安全的地方。由於這段期間股價可能持續下跌，穩健的做法是暫停建立新倉，而不是急於撈底。至於現有持倉，則可依靠預設的止蝕位來控制風險。
